Aaron — thanks for the attachments, they helped. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Demo iframe copy: keep it tight and prescriptive. Suggested hero line + CTA: 
- Headline: "Try the interactive demo — 3-minute guided workflow"
- Subline: "Experience query-to-insight with a preloaded sample dataset (no signup required)."
- CTA button: "Open demo" (opens iframe in new tab or modal; avoid "Start free trial")

Notes: AWS prefers not to see language that implies credits/paid features are included in the iframe. We should avoid "full product" or pricing promises. If you want an alternate CTA for users who want a trial, use a secondary link: "Request a trial" -> link to your trial form.

2) AMI naming & tags: recommended minimal pattern and tags we use for Marketplace readiness: 
- AMI Name pattern: acme-analytics-demo-YYYYMMDD-ami
- Required tags: Product, Version, Publisher, Visibility (public/private-prefill), BuildHash

I'll loop Jonas for the UI/UX placement of the iframe copy on the product page and Kimberly for legal/marketplace policy sign-off.

Action items:
- Aaron: can you update the AMI name to the pattern above and populate the 5 tags?
- Kimberly: please confirm policy okay on the suggested copy.
- Jonas: recommend modal vs new-tab behavior for the iframe.

Thanks,
Irene Choi

Aaron / Irene / team — quick legal/marketplace check from my side. The suggested copy from Irene is safe and aligns with AWS marketplace policies provided the demo is clearly labeled and does not collect payment info. A couple of small edits I recommend for the subline and CTA affordance: 

- Subline tweak: "Experience query-to-insight with a preloaded sample dataset — no signup required." (replace parentheses)
- CTA alt text: add aria-label and ensure it opens in a new tab (policy recommends not altering the marketplace navigation)

Also: for AMI visibility, confirm whether the AMI will be public or private during review — AWS reviewers sometimes prefer a private AMI with a temporary access window; they can request access during validation. If you plan to keep it public, document that in the notes field of your publisher submission.

I'll sign off on the copy once you confirm the AMI visibility and the final one-liner.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Marketplace Compliance
